stem_book: A uniform rod of length L and mass M lies on a smooth horizontal table. A particle of mass m moving on the table with speed v strikes the rod perpendicularly at one end and sticks to the rod after the collision. Find the velocity of the particle with respect to C (the centre of mass of rod + particle) before the collision.
correct_answer: Mv/(M + m), along the particle's motion
reason: missing from manifest; print refers to 'the previous problem' — setup (Level-4 Q7 rod) written into the stem
work: v − v_C = v − mv/(M + m) = Mv/(M + m)
